name: ElevenLabs Voice Channel
summary: Connects the ElevenLabs Conversational AI agent to this tenant. Points the agent's custom-llm Server URL at the tenant's public voice-proxy endpoint.
notes: On a tenant VPS the proxy is reached via the tenant domain through the base reverse proxy; no tunnel needed. The registration script PATCHes the ElevenLabs agent to use custom-llm at the public URL.
